September 8, 2026


# Varex Imaging Board of Directors Member, Dr. Jocelyn Chertoff wins RSNA Gold Medal


We are proud to congratulate Dr. Jocelyn Chertoff, member of the Varex Imaging Board of Directors, on being named an RSNA 2026 Gold Medalist. The RSNA Gold Medal is the Radiological Society of North America’s highest honor, recognizing individuals who have rendered exceptional service to the science of radiology. We are proud to congratulate Dr. Jocelyn Chertoff, member of the Varex Imaging Board of Directors, on being named an RSNA 2026 Gold Medalist. The RSNA Gold Medal is the Radiological Society of North America’s highest honor, recognizing individuals who have rendered exceptional service to the science of radiology.
This prestigious recognition reflects Dr. Chertoff’s lasting contributions to radiology, medical education, and the advancement of imaging. We are honored to benefit from her leadership and expertise as we continue supporting innovation across the imaging ecosystem.
Congratulations, Dr. Chertoff, on this extraordinary achievement.
Learn more about the award here:[Awards & recognition | RSNA](https://www.rsna.org/annual-meeting/awards-recognition)
